subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers repair or replace the open linked fix PR, or intentionally defer this transcript cwd isolation bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and session/security sensitive, but an open external PR already owns the same closing path and is currently conflicting, so ClawSweeper should not queue a parallel fix PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair or replace the linked fix PR
options.body: Adopt, rebase, or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 with a narrow current-main fix for explicit transcript header cwd.

options.title: Defer but keep this issue open
options.body: Leave this issue as the canonical bug if maintainers want broader cwd/workspace cleanup before changing transcript headers.

options.title: Accept current behavior
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining ordinary mirror fallback is acceptable despite the source and production evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the linked fix PR
recommendation.body: Adopt, rebase, or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 with a narrow current-main fix for explicit transcript header cwd.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing owner from the delivery mirroring feature history and the current issue mentions him in the maintainer context.
